description.en:
After seven years trapped in the Devil Grand Duke’s dungeon, Luculia is finally free, but her savior is not the prince she imagined. 

Davierre Montefeltro, a temperamental duke, unexpectedly takes her in. As Luculia adjusts to life outside the dungeon, mysteries swirl around Duke Davierre’s intentions. 

Can Luculia find happiness at last, or is this new life just another dungeon?

악마 대공의 지하 감옥에 7년간 갇혀 유령을 보던 소녀, 루클리아.
어느날 감옥 벽이 무너지고 한 남자가 찾아왔다.

"와, 왕자님이에요?"
"미안, 일개 공작이야."

몬테펠트로 가문의 공작, 다비에르.
변덕스럽고 살벌한 성격에 아니나 다를까,
정체도 모를 소녀인 루클리아를
공비로 맞이하겠다고?!

"공작님, 설마 그 분을 데려오신 이유가…"

description.ru:
Луклия — девушка, которая семь лет провела в темнице дьявольского герцога, видев все эти годы лишь призраков. Однажды стена тюрьмы рухнула, и в проеме появился мужчина.

«Вы принц?..»
«Прости, всего лишь герцог».

Давьер, герцог дома Монтенфельтро. Имея темпераментный и жестокий характер,
он взял Луклию, неизвестную девушку, как свою герцогиню?!

«Герцог, все в замешательстве, зачем вы привезли эксперимент дьявола сюда…»

Смогут ли эти два человека понять друг друга, став счастливыми?

'Woobin', who uses his good looks to seduce rich women and has lived like trash. 

He ends up falling in love with 'Suzy', a chaebol heir who was only supposed to be a target of his seduction.

He experiences the sweetness of love for the first time, 

But it lasts only for a while because what's hidden behind Suzy's angel-like appearance begins to slowly choke Woobin. 

A romance story of two trash-like humans who can't even be recycled!

단지 유혹의 대상이었던 재벌 상속녀 '수지'를 역으로 사랑해버리게 된다. 
처음으로 찾아온 사랑의 달콤함도 잠시, 
천사 같은 그녀의 겉모습 뒤에 감춰진 악취는 우빈을 점점 옥죄여오기 시작하는데...

description.pt-br: Woobin é um especialista em seduzir mulheres ricas com sua bela aparência e vive dos presentes que recebe delas. Ele se aproxima da rica e bela Suji para atacá-la… mas acaba se apaixonando! Cego pelo amor, Woobin não percebe que Suji não é o anjo que ele pensava que ela era, mas sim que tem um lado negro que lentamente o envolve. Cada um com intenções claramente diferentes, Woobin e Suji caem em um romance que não pode ser reciclado!

description.en:
I pray every dayfor this love to die.
That I may love you only until today,
and by tomorrow, may this love be dead.

-Born of an affair, the ill-fated imperial princess Thalia Roem Guirta.

She grows up twisted beneath the neglect of indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings,
and servants who look upon her with contempt.
To survive, Thalia learns to protect herself by baring her thorns at everyone who comes near.
And yet, even she becomes utterly defenseless before one man.

That man is Varkas Raedgo Seorkan, the noble young lord of the East.

A vassal of the imperial family and heir to a grand duke,
he was raised under relentless pressure to be perfect.
Shaped by discipline so harsh it bordered on abuse,
he grew up with most of his emotions long since numbed.
A man who exists solely for his family’s honor and duty.

To keep a promise made to the late empress,
he becomes engaged to Ayla, Thalia’s half-sister.

And Thalia, consumed by despair, begins to slowly break apart.

But then—

the love fated to end in her death reaches an unexpected turning point….

description.en:
Her tenth year since debut, the two-time consecutive year-end grand award winner: Baek Nokha, the undisputed representative female soloist of South Korea.

On what should have been her greatest day—a day where she was to receive another grand award—the unexpected news of her mother’s death turned it into her worst.

“Do you want to save your mom?"

A mysterious cottonball appears in front of the sorrowful Nokha. It says that if she accepts its proposal and fulfills it, it will bring her mom back to life.

“I don’t know what kind of proposal this is, but I accept.”

To return to that moment before everything changed, Nokha accepts the proposal. After making a contract with the cottonball, she opens her eyes in another person’s body.

Then…

[System]
[Congratulations!
You have become "Yoon Chung."]

[From now on, you are a member of a girl group destined to fail.]

[You must save Still Blue!]

Can Nokha, now member Yoon Chung, save the girl group from its destiny of failure?

The spread of a virus of the national disaster proportion has shut down Seoul! Haebin, who lost all of his classmates in an incident a year before, left home in order to avoid being alone again. What is the unexpected truth awaiting him that keeps him from regaining his normal daily life?!

"Child, you must survive!"

After the destruction of his House by his uncle, all that was left for a young boy, Boris, was the heirloom sword, Winterer. But little did he know that this treasure would become the cause of another crisis. As people seek Winterer, Boris’ heart grows colder and bleaker, much like the winter.

The adventures of Boris — to survive and to protect the sword of his House — begin now. What awaits him at the end of this journey? And what secrets does the winter sword Winterer hold?

description.en:
‘I was sad just for being reincarnated with a dirt spoon, and now you’re telling me I also have to marry because of a debt?’

Not just that, but the person who will be my husband is the Heir Apparent of Duke Hessenweitz, the monster from all those horrifying rumors!

“A monster doesn’t deserve good treatment.”

However, in the castle of the duke, I saw my young husband being abused for being a monster. I felt pity for my young husband and since he was more like a younger brother to me, I tried to be a little nicer to him…

“You are my miracle and my salvation.”

Only… I didn’t expect this kind of reaction at all? And not just that…

“If I had a daughter who resembles my wife, she would be like you!”

No, why are you doing this to me? Even the father-in-law who had a bad temper? Can I survive in this duke’s castle safely?

---
Upon marrying into the powerful Hessenweitz duchy, Ellie Blanchett arrives at her new home and quickly learns that behind the prestige lies a deeply dysfunctional family. Her husband Zachary, heir to the duchy, is considered a monster by his own father, who scorns him for his supernatural powers. But as Ellie discovers, her husband is not only kind, but cute too! Stuck in the middle of this father-son drama, can Ellie help Zachary accept his powers and stand up to his dad once and for all?

description.en:
As captain of the holy knights, Celia excels at protecting the country from monsters. So, when a priestess tasks her with raising a baby nine-tailed fox, Celia is hesitant but does her best to help the creature. Despite the abuse he has endured from other humans, she manages to gain some of his trust and names him Rahn. They start getting along, but the crafty fox is always looking for a way to escape. Can Celia raise Rahn until he's an adult, or will this sly fox pull one over his holy knight?
___
One day, I met a spirit. And it wasn't just anyone, but a gumiho puppy. As I worried about the little one's fate, I met a priestess from the eastern continent, who told me to raise him until he reached maturity and then send him back home. Raising a little fox...

How could a cursed human welcome and care for a young life? It was strange and scary, but I couldn't refuse.

The fox, Ran, was just adorable. So, with much love and care, I raised him... But when he grew up, he became as seductive as I've heard of his kind, and he refused to be independent. All the training he had given seemed to have been in vain, with that lewd look.

"You can’t run away."
"Keep being good and help me, Scyllia. By my side."

Forever...
description.fr:
Un jour, j'ai rencontré un esprit. Et ce n'était pas n'importe qui, mais un renard à 9 queues. Alors que je m'inquiétais du sort de ce petit, j'ai rencontré une prêtresse du continent oriental m'ayant dit de l'élever jusqu'à ce qu'il atteigne la maturité, puis de le renvoyer chez lui. Élever un petit renard... Comment une humaine maudite pourrait-elle accueillir et prendre soin d'un si petit être? C'était étrange et effrayant, mais je ne pouvais pas refuser. Le renard, Ran, était tout simplement adorable. Je l'ai donc élevé avec beaucoup d'amour et de soin... Mais quand il a grandi, et est devenu aussi séduisant que je l'avais entendu dire de son espèce, et il a refusé d'être indépendant. Toute la formation qu'il avait reçue semblait avoir été vaine, avec ce regard lubrique.

«Tu ne peux pas t'enfuir.»

«Aide-moi à rester bon, Scyllia. À mes côtés.»

Pour toujours...
description.id: Scyllia, seorang Paladin dari Benua Barat. Saat menundukkan siluman yang diselundupkan, dia menemukan energi siluman rubah yang tidak biasa, jadi dia berniat untuk membawanya, namun ditengah itu, dia bertemu pendeta wanita dari Benua Timur. Dan setelah diselidiki siluman rubah itu adalah gumiho. Jika kau tidak ingin melihatnya menjadi iblis neraka, kau harus membesarkannya dan membawanya ke Benua Timur, jadi dia bekerja keras untuk membesarkannya... "Aku lebih buruk dari binatang, dan kamu tahu itu kan, Scyllia?" "..." "Jangan khawatir. Kamu mengajariku dengan baik. Jadi aku tidak akan melakukan sesuatu yang berbahaya." "...." “Tapi kamu tidak bisa lari.” ....Aku yakin membesarkannya dengan hati-hati... "Bantu aku untuk bersikap baik, Scyllia, dan tetaplah berada di sampingku." Selamanya. Gumiho katanya terlahir dengan roh nafsu yang memikat seseorang dan memakannya. Anak laki-laki, yang sudah tumbuh dewasa tanpa diduga menolak untuk mandiri. Однажды я встретила духа. И не абы какого, а маленького кумихо. Беспокоясь о его судьбе, я спросила совета у жрицы с Восточного континента, а она сказала мне вырастить кумихо и отправить его домой. description.de: Aufgrund einer chronischen Krankheit verbringt Prinzessin Juliet ihr Leben innerhalb der Mauern des Königspalastes von Rozenta, wo es mit Ausnahme ihres Bruders keinerlei Gleichaltrige gibt. Als eines Tages ein junger Diener namens Lete auftaucht und ihr Gesellschaft leistet, ist Juliet außer sich vor Freude. Aber ihre gemeinsamen Spaziergänge finden ein jähes Ende, als Juliet plötzlich Enoch Letrachi, den Erzherzog des benachbarten Reiches Herventel, heiraten soll. Aber dem nicht genug: Ihr zukünftiger Ehemann ist in Wahrheit Lete, ihr ehemaliger Gefährte, und will sich ihr erst wieder zeigen, wenn der Ehevertrag unterzeichnet ist. Was hat das alles zu bedeuten? Und wird Juliet ihr Glück finden können, wenn ihr Vertrauen in ihren Geliebten doch so schnell im Keim erstickt wurde?
description.en:
Enoch Latraki loves his wife, Juliet, even though she doesn’t love him back. But one day, she suddenly changes, becoming gentle and kind. Enoch is determined to find out why his wife has become so affectionate.

---
Due to her terminal illness, Princess Juliet has spent her entire life inside the Rozenta Kingdom's palace without any peers to talk to. So she's delighted to meet a kind young servant named Lete who provides her with much-needed company. However, their pleasant strolls end abruptly when Juliet is suddenly told to marry the archduke of Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. What comes as a greater shock is that Lete is actually Enoch, and that he has refused to see Juliet until she signs the marriage papers! Can Juliet find happiness when her trust in her husband-to-be has already been shattered?
description.fr: La princesse Juliet, victime d’une maladie incurable, a passé toute sa vie dans le palais du royaume de Rozenta sans pouvoir parler aux gens de son âge. Quelle surprise alors lorsqu’elle rencontre Lete, un jeune et charmant domestique, qui lui apporte enfin la compagnie dont elle avait tant besoin! Leurs agréables promenades prennent toutefois fin brutalement au moment où Juliet est sommée d'épouser l'archiduc de Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. Mais le choc est d’autant plus grand quand Juliet apprend que Lete est en fait Enoch et qu'il refuse de la voir tant qu'elle n'aura pas signé les papiers du mariage! Juliet pourra-t-elle trouver le bonheur alors que sa confiance en son futur mari a déjà été brisée?
description.id: Akibat sakit-sakitan seumur hidupnya, Juliet tak bisa menjalani hidup 'biasa' sebagai seorang putri Kerajaan Rosenta. Sebersit kebahagiaan menghampirinya saat ia bertemu dengan seorang pelayan dari delegasi Kekaisaran Nassant, dan menghabiskan waktu dengannya. Namun, kebahagiannya tidak berlangsung lama, karena Juliet ternyata akan dinikahkan dengan Grand Duke dari Herventel, Enoch Letrachi, yang selama ini ia kira pelayan. Bisakah Juliet mencintai pria tersebut, di saat ia tak lagi bisa percaya padanya?

Filled with rage, she meets Jade Ferrado, a powerful duke who can help her enact revenge. Robelia asks him to become her sponsor, but he'll only do so if she agrees to marry him. She signs the papers, and with the duke's resources now at her disposal, Robelia is ready to wreak vengeance! However, she soon discovers that her uncle isn't the only one behind her woes...

---
"About your curse, I’ll try to solve it. But in return, please accept me as your blood relative."

From the information in the original, she knew the reason why her mother died. Robelia suddenly remembered her current situation, deprived of everything and pushed to the end. So she decided to take revenge.

She successfully escapes her uncle's control and quickly plans to take back what belongs to her. She reached out to Duke Ferrado, who was known to be fraught with danger, and made her proposal.

"I know a better way. I was thinking about creating a contract marriage, what do you think?"

He suddenly came up with a rather unexpected proposal. Robelia has shaken her uncle’s capital thanks to his support.

In front of her, the original heroine and the enemy's daughter appeared as love rivals to her.

"Well, sis, why did you change so quickly?"

Can Robelia get her revenge perfectly?

"When everything comes to an end, I want to be by your side"

And can she have a happy ending with the man she woos?

This pompous heir is certainly a force to be reckoned with, but if anyone can tame him, it's her.

description.en:
Her life was nothing but lies. Camellia was just 12 when she was taken away from her mother in the slums and forced to live as the son of an aristocratic family. But under the layers of secrets and lies, she never forgets. She continues to struggle to be her true self again, to reclaim the life of Camellia.

---
Camellia was a flower born of a street rat, her face more ethereal than any other. When she was a child, a wealthy noblewoman took her and forced her to become Camellius Bale, the second-born son of House Bale. From that day on, her life was no longer her own.

For years, Camellius has lived to protect the position of her older brother, Kieran, even though this does not benefit her at all. With nowhere to run, she obeys her stepmother's orders, burying herself deep beneath a facade of lies. As she begins to cross paths with Claude del Ihar, the heir to the grand dukedom, she continues to hope that someday she can reclaim what was once hers—the life of Camellia.

description.fr:

Mais malgré son secret et tout les mensonges autour d’elle, elle n'oublie pas qui elle est. Elle continue de lutter pour redevenir elle-même, afin de récupérer sa vie d’avant, sa vie de Camellia.

---
Dans la peau d'un garçon

Enlevée à l'âge de 12 ans, Camélia, une petite fille née dans la pauvreté, est forcée de prendre l’apparence d’un garçon : Camélius, le second fils de la noble famille Bale. Malgré une vie remplie de mensonges, Camélia est bien déterminée à retrouver son ancienne identité et sa mère disparue...

description.de: Der Legende nach wird eines Tages ein Mann mit schwarzem Haar und roten Augen der kaiserlichen Familie von Den Helder den Untergang bringen. Mit genau diesen Eigenschaften geboren, wird der junge Prinz Rayton im Palast gemieden und ist weithin bekannt und gefürchtet als „der Verfluchte“. Als der rachsüchtige Prinz Jahre später einen blutigen Aufstand anzettelt, stirbt auch die junge, machtlose Prinzessin Setz durch sein Schwert. Was Setz nicht weiß, ist, dass sie fünf Jahre in der Vergangenheit in ihrem eigenen Körper wiedererwachen wird – ihre Gelegenheit, sich mit Rayton gut zu stellen und ihr Schicksal zu ändern. Die kalte Mauer um Rayton herum einzureißen, ist eine Herausforderung, aber sobald es ihr gelingt, gibt es kein Zurück mehr! Als Rayton sich mehr und mehr auf sie einlässt, wird Setz immer weiter in die dunklen Verschwörungen des Palastes verwickelt. Ist die Prinzessin ihrem Tod wirklich entkommen oder befindet sie sich in größerer Gefahr als je zuvor?
description.en:
Legend has it that a man with black hair and red eyes will bring ruin to Den Helder's royal family. Because he was born with these features, Rayton is shunned by the palace as "the cursed one." When the vengeful prince stages a bloody *coup d'état* years later, the powerless youngest princess, Setz, also died by his sword. Little does Setz know that she's about to wake up in her body five years in the past-- but now that she has, it's her chance to get on Rayton's good side and turn her fate around. Cracking the prince's cold exterior is a challenge, but once she does, there seems to be no going back! As Rayton grows more and more attached to her, Setz is pulled deeper into the midst of the dark conspiracies brewing around the palace. Has the princess truly escaped death, or is she in more danger than ever before?
___
Her brother, who was the one who caused a *coup d'état*, had sliced her throat. After she returned to the time before she died, she decided that she would somehow tame him and survive! But… Did she tame him too well?

"Brother, why don't you get married?"

There was no reply from him instead, the glass that he held popped and cracked.

"Oh no, you're bleeding."

"Why should I get married?"

"Eh?"

"I already have you."

Why should I get married you say? You have to get a consort so I can leave this castle! Sezh laughed strangely.

"Sezh."

At that moment, she stumbled and Raytan pulled her body into his arms. His red eyes started to gleam suggestively while looking down at Sezh who was trapped in his arms.

"You know we are not real siblings."

En cambio, el vaso en la mano de Raytan se quebró y crujió con un sonido.—Dios mío, estás sangrando.—¿Por qué tengo que casarme?—¿Eh?—Tú, estás aquí."¿Por qué tienes que casarte? ¡Tienes que encontrar una Emperatriz rápidamente, para que pueda salir de este castillo tranquilamente!"Sezh sonrió de una forma poco natural.—Oh, mi dios.Por un momento, el cuerpo de Sezh tembló. Raytan la levantó y la rodeo como si estuviera encerradola en sus brazos. Los ojos rojos que miraban a Sezh mientras la tenia atrapada brillaron siniestramente.—¿Sabes? No somos hermanos reales.
description.fr: Une légende raconte qu'un homme aux yeux rouges et aux cheveux noirs apportera destruction et misère sur la famille royale... et c'est pour cela que Rayton est condamné à souffrir, rejeté, discriminé, et traité d'enfant maudit juste à cause de son apparence. Il décide alors de se venger en assassinant toutes les personnes qui possèdent les caractéristiques physiques des membres de la famille royale. Setz se retrouve ainsi tuée à cause de ses longs cheveux blonds et de ses yeux azur alors qu'elle n'avait rien fait de mal. Lorsqu'elle se réveille, la voilà revenue cinq ans en arrière, et prête à tout faire pour éviter un destin tragique. Il est temps pour elle de s'allier avec Rayton pour lui montrer qu'elle est de son côté contre ces gens qui le harcèlent et s'en prennent également à elle. Mais plus elle se rapproche de lui plus elle se retrouve mêlée aux sombres affaires de la famille royale. Va-t-elle vraiment réussir à échapper à la mort, ou un destin encore plus funeste va lui faire face?
description.id: Kakaknya, yang menyebabkan kudeta, telah memenggal lehernya. Setelah dia kembali ke waktu sebelum dia meninggal, dia memutuskan bahwa dia entah bagaimana akan menjinakkannya dan bertahan hidup! TETAPI--- Apakah dia terlalu banyak menjinakkannya? Monolog: "Kakak, kenapa kamu tidak menikah?" Tidak ada jawaban darinya, gelas yang dipegangnya pecah dan pecah. "Oh tidak, kau berdarah." "Kenapa aku harus menikah?" "Eh?" "Aku sudah memilikimu." MC: "Kenapa aku harus menikah katamu? Kamu harus mendapatkan Permaisuri agar aku bisa meninggalkan kastil ini!" Tapi kakaknya memeluknya, mata merahnya menatapnya dan berkata "Kau tahu kita bukan saudara kandung." Dia (FL) berencana untuk membuat saudaranya mengirimnya ke kerajaan lain begitu dia menjadi kaisar. ML diganggu pada masa kecilnya serta MC kami sejak dia mulai membantunya - keduanya mengorbankan diri mereka untuk satu sama lain karena mereka tersiksa dalam masyarakat istana dan dia menjadi lebih terobsesi dengannya. Tapi pada awalnya dia bersikap acuh tak acuh, yah jelas itulah sifat tsundere yang kami dapatkan di sana. (Begitulah cara dia menjinakkannya).
description.ja: デンヘルデル帝国では「闇のような漆黒の髪と血のように赤い瞳の怪物が全てを破壊するだろう」という言い伝えがありました。しかしある日皇帝の寵愛を受けた踊り子が言い伝え通りの子どもを産み落とすと事態は一変します。 呪われた子だと信じられているその子を皇帝は何度も殺そうとしますが、何をやっても効果はありませんでした。そして「レイタン(呪われた子)」と名付けられます。 レイタンは幼い頃から虐げられ痛めつけられながら息を殺して生きてきました。 しかし23歳の時母の死をきっかけに復讐が始まります。 皇室の人間である証の金髪碧眼の者を容赦なく皆殺しにするレイタン。 その対象は同じように皇宮で育ちながらも母の身分の低さから冷遇され実の母親からも虐待を受けて育ってきたセッツも例外ではありませんでした。 助けてほしいと必死で訴えますが聞き入れられず容赦なく首を斬り落とされます。 その瞬間あまりの理不尽さに恨みが募るセッツ。 一体自分が何をしたというのか…皇宮では兄妹から虐められ母からも虐待を受けて誰からも愛されず辛く寂しい時間を過ごしてきた自分がレイタンの虐めをなす術もなく傍観していたことがそれほど罪深いことなのかと…目覚めるとそこは5年前でした。初めは夢かと疑いますが段々これが現実だと悟るセッツ。今度こそ兄であるレイタンに取り入って生き残って見せると決意しますが…
description.ko:
"쿠테타를 일을킨 오빠에게 목이 잘려 죽었다. 회귀한 후, 결심했다.
어떻게든 저 놈을 구워삶아서 살아남고 말겠다고! 그런데......
너무 구워삶았나?

"오라버니, 이제 슬슬 혼인을 하셔야지 않겠어요?"

돌아오는 대답은 없었다. 대신, 레이탄의 손에 쥐어진 잔이 쩍, 소리를 내며 갈라졌다.

"세상에, 피가 나잖아요."
"내가 왜 혼인을 해야 하지?"
"네?"
"네가 있는데."

왜 혼인을 해야 하냐니! 네가 얼른 황후를 맞아야 내가 이 성을 뜨든지 말든지 하지! 세쯔가 부자연스럽게 웃었다.

"세쯔."

순간 세쯔의 몸이 휘청였다. 세쯔를 잡아당긴 레이탄은 그녀를 제 품에 가두듯 안았다. 품에 갇힌 세쯔를 내려다보는 빨간색 눈동자가 음험하게 빛났다.

"너도 알고 있잖아? 우리가 친남매가 아니라는 걸."
description.ru:
Её брат устроил государственный переворот и перерезал ей горло. Вернувшись назад во времени, она решила, что как-нибудь приручит его и выживет!Но… Неужели она приручила его слишком хорошо?

«Брат, почему бы тебе не жениться?»«Зачем мне жениться?»

«А?»

«У меня уже есть ты.»

Сеж неестественно рассмеялась.

«Сеж.»

В этот момент она споткнулась, и Рейтан притянул её к себе.

«Ты же знаешь, что мы ненастоящие брат и сестра.»
description.vi:
Tôi đã bị chém đầu bởi người anh trai gây ra cuộc đảo chính.
Sau khi được quay ngược về quá khứ, tôi đã quyết tâm.
Bằng bất cứ giá nào cũng phải thuần hóa được tên đó và sống sót!
Thế nhưng….
Tôi đã thuần hóa quá mức rồi sao?
“anh à, giờ không phải đã đến lúc anh dần tính đến chuyện hôn nhân rồi sao?”
Không có câu trả lời. thay vào đó, chiếc ly trong tay Reitan bỗng phát ra âm thanh “rắc” rồi vỡ tan tành.
“Ôi trời, anh chảy máu rồi.”
“Sao ta lại phải kết hôn chứ?”
“Sao ạ?”
“Ta đã có em ở đây rồi mà.”
Anh hỏi sao lại phải kết hôn á! Anh phải nhanh chóng gặp hoàng hậu thì tôi mới có thể rời khỏi thành chứ! Setz cười gượng gạo.
“Setz.”
Trong thoáng chốc, cơ thể Setz loạng choạng như sắp ngã. Setz bị Reitan nắm kéo lại ôm trọn vào lòng. Đôi mắt đỏ của Reitan chầm chầm nhìn xuống Setz đang trong vòng tay chợt ánh lên một tia xảo quyệt.
“Em cũng biết rõ mà? Chuyện chúng ta không phải là anh em ruột.”
description.pt-br:
Seu irmão, que causou o golpe de Estado, cortou sua garganta. Após ela voltar no tempo, um tempo ante de sua morte, ela decidiu que de alguma forma iria domesticá-lo e sobreviver! Mas… Ela o domesticou demais?

"Irmão, por que você não se casa?"
Mas não houve resposta dele, o vidro que ele segurava estalou e rachou.
"Oh não, você está sangrando."
“Por que eu deveria me casar?”
"Eh?"
"Eu já tenho você."
Por que você deveria se casar, você diz? Você tem que arranjar uma Imperatriz para que eu poder deixar este castelo! Mas Sezh apenas riu estranhamente sem dizer o que pensava.
"Sezh."
Nesse momento, ela tropeçou e Raytan a puxou para os seus braços. Seus olhos vermelhos começaram a brilhar sugestivamente enquanto olhava para Sezh, que estava presa em seus braços.
"Você sabe que não somos irmãos de verdade."

She would have to marry the son of another organization?!

Yang Hye-jin had completely cut ties with her family right after she entered college, in pursuit of peaceful a daily life. It has been nine years since she left her violent father and her ignorant brother, who resembled him. However, her family suddenly appears and unilaterally announces her marriage with an unwanted partner, Moo Kang. Can Hye-jin and Moo Kang swear their entire lives in this marriage, which consists of a contract between organizations, and where death is the only path should they do not accept it?

---
The Yang and Kim families were once rival gangs with construction company fronts that spilled blood over a smidgen of gold. But a new company has entered the picture, and now both their stakes are at risk. Reluctantly, they form an alliance… sealed with an arranged marriage between their children, Hyejin and Moogahng! However, Hyejin’s past traumas keep her heart guarded, and Moogahng shrouds himself in mystery. It doesn’t seem like any amount of blood, tears, or gold will make their marriage better. description.en:
Crystal Rotary.

She was the youngest daughter of the Rotary family and a fragile girl who did not come out of the annexe due to her weakness.

Her true identity was male.

Only women were kept alive in the family, and men either become corpses or heirs.

Crystal’s only goal was to leave the Rotary family and live a normal life.

In order for him to survive, he grew up as a daughter. He held his breath like a dead person.

He was finally about to leave, what did they mean, get married?

Crystal, driven into a corner, proposed marriage to Grand Duke Pentrine, who was politically at odds with the Rotary family.

Crystal thought the Grank Duke would refuse, of course, but he got a reply instead. 

Crystal escaped to the Great Castle of Pentrin.

He was a cold northern master, a cruel man, and a man with an icy heart.

Crystal met the rumoured Ellian Pentrin.

And got married. What happened?

***

“You don’t have to be so nervous. I won’t do anything to you.”

On their first night as a couple, Crystal was told that the consummation was not going to happen.

‘What does this mean? Are you saying we’re going to break up?’

Ellian whispered at a distance where his breath could reach only him.

“I’m sorry, my Lady… Because I am a eunuch.”

Ellian Pentrin said in the sweetest voice in the world.

description.de: Als Karina in einem Roman aufwacht, realisiert sie, dass ihr die Möglichkeit gegeben wurde, das tragische Leben des männlichen Protagonisten Roland Bleuet und seiner Schwester Melisa zu verändern. Als ein Dienstmädchen des Hauses versucht Karina so viel Geld zu sparen, wie sie nur kann, um die beiden aus den Fängen ihres Onkels Renke zu befreien und sie in Sicherheit zu bringen. Als es so weit ist, muss sie mit Entsetzen feststellen, dass das Geld nicht reicht, um sie alle drei in die Hauptstadt zu bringen. Stattdessen fahren sie nach Torres, wo Karina den Herzog Claude Torres kennenlernt, einen Adeligen, der davon besessen ist, talentierte Menschen zu sammeln. Doch dem nicht genug: Er ist es auch, der Rolands Leben als Antagonist des Romans in Zukunft negativ beeinflussen wird. Wird es Karina gelingen, ihre Adoptivkinder zu beschützen und ihnen eine bessere Zukunft zu bieten?
description.en:
When Karina wakes up inside a novel, she realizes she’s been given a chance to change the tragic lives of the male lead, Roland Bleuet, and his sister, Melisa. Karina saves up as much money as she can and makes a run for it with the children. But to her dismay, the money she has saved up isn’t enough to get the three of them to the capital. Instead, they head for Torres where Karina bumps into Duke Claude Torres, a “talent fanatic” who is obsessed with collecting talented individuals and an antagonist who will negatively impact Roland’s life in the future. Will Karina be able to protect Roland and Melisa from all dangers and give her adoptive children a better future?
___

description.es: Cuando Karina se despierta dentro de una novela, se da cuenta de que se le ha dado la oportunidad de cambiar las trágicas vidas del protagonista, Roland Bleuet, y su hermana, Melisa. Karina ahorra todo el dinero que puede y logra escapar con los niños. Pero para su mala suerte, el dinero que ha ahorrado no es suficiente para llevarlos a los tres a la capital. En cambio, se dirigen a Torres, donde Karina se encuentra con el duque Claude Torres, un "fanático del talento" que está obsesionado con coleccionar personas talentosas y un antagonista que tendrá un impacto negativo en la vida de Roland en el futuro. ¿Podrá Karina proteger a Roland y Melisa de todos los peligros? ¿Podrá darles un futuro mejor a sus hijos adoptivos?
description.fr: Lorsque je me suis soudain réveillée à l’intérieur d’un roman, et qui plus est, dans le corps de Karina, la servante de Roland Bleuet, le personnage principal, j’ai décidé de saisir cette opportunité pour changer le destin tragique de ce petit garçon ainsi que celui de sa sœur, Melisa. Après avoir économisé autant d’argent que possible, j’ai réussi à convaincre les enfants de quitter le manoir de leur oncle malveillant et de me suivre pour s’échapper ensemble vers la capitale. Malheureusement, il faut bien plus d’argent que ce que je pensais pour s’y rendre. C’est pourquoi nous séjournerons d’abord à Torres, de façon temporaire. Mais c’est là que se trouve le duc Claude Torres, un homme obsédé par les personnes de talent, qui essaie de les utiliser à son avantage. Ayant lu l’histoire, je sais bien que le duc Torres est un antagoniste qui aura un impact extrêmement négatif sur la vie de Roland à l’avenir. Je dois à tout prix l’empêcher de le rencontrer! Vais-je parvenir à protéger Roland et Melisa des dangers qui les menacent? Pourrai-je offrir à ces enfants l’avenir qu’ils méritent?
description.id: "Aku akan membuat anak-anak ini bahagia. Karena itu alasanku datang ke dunia ini." Roland yang memiliki takdir menjadi penyihir agung di masa depan. Dan adiknya, Melisa. Serta Lenque, seseorang yang mengeksploitasi bakat Roland demi keuntungan dirinya. Karina Bloe, pengasuh Roland dan Melisa yang ternyata juga memiliki bakat sihir. Bermula dari Karina yang membawa Roland dan Melisa kabur dari mansion, namun... Siapa sangka dia harus menghindari seorang Duke di tempat tinggal barunya?!
description.ko:
"이 아이들을 행복하게 만들어 줄 거야. 
그게 내가 이 세계로 환생한 이유니까."
미래에 대마법사가 될 운명인 롤랜드와 그의 동생 멜리사. 
그리고 롤랜드의 재능을 착취하여 자신의 이익을 챙기려는 렝케. 
렝케의 감시를 피해서 롤랜드와 멜리사를 데리고 도망치겠어!
일단 렝케를 피해서 먼 도시로 도망치면 될 줄 알았는데…. 
아이들과의 관계가 어떻게 되냐고요? 
"저는… 이 아이들의 엄마예요! 
카리나 블로에입니다."
그렇게 겨우 도망친 곳이 왜 하필 클로드 공작의 영지인 거야?! 
인재만 보면 사족을 못 쓰고 영입하려 든다는 클로드 공작. 
'각하, 우리 아이들의 재능은 탐내시면 안 됩니다!'
"아무래도 나는… 블로에 부인이 탐이 나서 말이지."
이건 또 무슨 소리세요…? 
렝케를 피해서 도망쳤더니, 이젠 공작까지 피해 다녀야 하는 거야?!
description.pl: Kiedy Karina budzi się w powieści, zdaje sobie sprawę, że dostała szansę na zmianę tragicznego życia głównego bohatera, Rolanda Bleueta, i jego siostry, Melisy. Karina oszczędza tyle pieniędzy, ile może, i ucieka z dziećmi. Ale ku jej przerażeniu, pieniądze, które zaoszczędziła nie wystarczą, by zabrać całą trójkę do stolicy. Zamiast tego, kierują się do Torres, gdzie Karina wpada na księcia Claude'a Torresa, "fanatyka talentów", który ma obsesję na punkcie zbierania utalentowanych jednostek i antagonistę, który negatywnie wpłynie na życie Rolanda w przyszłości. Czy Karina będzie w stanie ochronić Rolanda i Melisę przed wszystkimi niebezpieczeństwami i zapewnić swoim przybranym dzieciom lepszą przyszłość?
description.ru: Когда Карина открывает глаза, она понимает, что оказалась в романе. Она полна решимости спасти главного героя и его сестру, но все идет не по плану и им приходится бежать из их родного дома...
description.vi:
Khi Karina tỉnh dậy trong quyển tiểu thuyết, cô ấy nhận ra rằng bản thân được trao cơ hội để thay đổi cuộc đời bị kịch của nam chính, Roland Bleuet, và em gái của anh ta, Melisa.

Karina tiết kiệm nhiều tiền nhất có thể và bỏ trốn cùng với hai đứa trẻ. Thất vọng thay, số tiền mà cô tích góp lại không đủ để đưa cả ba tới thủ đô. Thay vào đó, họ tới Torres, nơi Karina gặp Công tước Claude Torres, một kẻ “cuồng tài năng” bị ám ảnh bởi việc tập hợp những người có tài và một nhân vật phản diện ảnh hưởng tiêu cực đến cuộc sống của Roland trong tương lai. Liệu Karina có thể bảo vệ Roland và Melisa khỏi mọi hiểm nguy và cho hai anh em một tương lai tốt đẹp hơn không?
description.zh: "我这一世最大的愿望，就是让这些孩子能够获得幸福！" 为了摆脱恶毒舅舅的监视，我必须带着未来将成为大魔法师的两个孩子逃走！本来假装两个孩子的妈妈，结果却意外进入了公爵的地盘？！为什么公爵派来的人，却要我做公爵夫人？！

description.en:
A reader is magically transported into a BL novel called *The Night of Hwangseong*. She now inhabits the body of Lobelia Flore, the daughter of a noble family suffering from a rare illness. Lobelia discovers the only way to avoid a painful death is to remain in close physical contact with Edric Dencart, the young, beautiful, and sickly crown prince. To do this, Lobelia disguises herself as a man named “Lobel” and commits herself to becoming the crown prince’s most trusted man-servant.
____
In this world of a BL novel, I’ve died three times of the same rare disease as the sickly protagonist. I couldn't accept dying such a pathetic death. Thus, I took special measures.

'Let's try feeding a spoonful of the well-prepared medicine to the sickly protagonist!'
Young Master, I won’t miss a single drop of medicine, not even a breath!

I disguised myself as a servant to serve the sickly young master. Even the spirit power from his breath would heal me, so what could be better than this! But serving said individual was not easy…

“Get out! I said get out!! I’ve had enough of this!!! …Wait. What are you doing on your knees right now?”
“Young Master, if you’re going to throw it away, please throw it into my mouth.”

I said to him, who then withdrew his arm from throwing the medicine bottle in embarrassment.

"I wouldn’t mind if you just spray it onto my face instead…"

For a moment, his pupils dilated wildly.

====

I’m a do-if-you-must kind of girl.
While I was at it, I took good care of Young Master, who was my lifesaver.
As well as serving him, I hugged him, carried him, and brought him everywhere as his legs.

I wonder if he recognized my true value as the heir of a prestigious dukedom.
Young Master would occasionally gaze at me with intent, but he no longer tried to drive me away.

Now that I've recovered and repaid his kindness, it was time to figure out how I should leave…
But Young Master started acting strange.

“You said you like me so much, so why are you trying to run away?”
“...”
“You said you’d die without me.”

Before I knew it, he began to have the look of a hungry predator.

He succeeded in music composition and bought a house in Cheongdam-dong, but has become an arrogant celebrity.

description.en:
Ma-go has started her 44th life this year. She is paying the price for the book she wrote 500 years ago, “Record of a Dreamlike Romance”. 

“Until all of your books are eliminated, you can never have eternal rest.” 

A single book had twisted the destinies of many. So the angry God of fate sent down the reaper, Ha-rib, on an errand… 

After living many cursed lives, only 5 copies of her book remain! With her curse coming to an end, she started preparing for her final rest, but… 

“I’m publishing that old book ‘Record of a Dreamlike Romance’ as an e-book.” 

An unexpected interview with Gyu-jin, the CEO of an online bookstore! If he does that, she might never be able to break this curse! 

Also, he has a crazy resemblance to her first love…?

A woman trying to repay the karma for writing a cursed book, and… The grim reaper watching over her VS her reincarnated first love! 

A never-ending 500-year old romance between three souls!

그렇게 저주의 생을 살던 그녀에게 남은 책은 이제 고작 5권!

Once downtrodden and suicidal, Jinho transforms into an unstoppable force, stunning his family with unmatched martial arts skill. As his reputation soars, Jinho’s newfound strength sets him on a path to reshape his destiny and claim his place in a world that once cast him aside.

description.en:
I was reborn into a romance fiction novel. I am lowborn, but there are plenty of boys here, and I get to work for the nobles.

But there’s a tiny problem. This noble family happens to be a family of villains, and I’m supposed to lead these serpents and throw the empire into chaos. Apparently, I am the greatest villain in this novel!

The deaths, the chaos in the empire, and the matters of inheritance locked the duke’s children and me into a corner of the manor. But the novel never mentioned anything about being locked away. So here, I must survive and grow… for a villainous happily ever.
description.fr: J'ai été réincarnée dans un roman d'amour où je suis une servante qui travaille pour des nobles. Et pas n'importe quels nobles... les méchants de l'histoire ! Je suis censée devenir leur leader et les pousser à plonger le monde dans le chaos. Mais pour le moment, à cause de la peste qui ravage l'empire et des questions d'héritage, les enfants du duc et moi sommes confinés dans une tour du manoir familial. Pourtant, il n'est pas fait mention de captivité dans le roman... Il ne me reste plus qu'à survivre tout en trouvant comment mener les méchants à une fin heureuse.

She also raised the child’s self-esteem, and made the Duke act like a proper father, as fatherly love was essential for the male protagonist’s self-esteem.

She thought the child was gradually recovering his bright face, and the Duke was now learning how to gradually give love to the child.

Als Baek Hayul in einer fremden Welt als Herzogin Aila Rinehart aufwacht, ist ihr erster Gedanke, dass sie von dort verschwinden muss. Ihr Ehemann, Herzog Claude Rinehart ist der Bösewicht der Geschichte „Prinz, mein Prinz“, der wegen Verrats an der Krone hingerichtet wird. Hayul hat nicht vor, an der Seite ihres neuen Ehemanns zu sterben, und verlangt von ihm die Scheidung. Aber als Claude zum wiederholten Male ihren Wunsch nach Scheidung ablehnt, bleibt ihr nichts anderes übrig, als mit ihm einen Deal einzugehen. Sie gibt ihrem Mann einen Monat, ihre Liebe zu gewinnen und ihre Gefühle ihm gegenüber zu ändern. Sie ist fest dazu entschlossen, dies nicht geschehen zu lassen, aber je mehr Zeit sie zusammen mit Claude verbringt, desto unruhiger und unsicherer wird sie. When Baek Hayul wakes up in a foreign world as Duchess Aila Rinehart, she knows she has to escape. Her husband, Duke Claude Rinehart, is the antagonist of the story, “Prince, My Prince,” who gets executed for plotting a revolt against the crown. Hayul has no intention of dying alongside her new husband and demands a divorce. But when Claude turns down her repeated requests to end their marriage, she has no choice but to propose a deal. She gives Claude one month to win her love and change her mind, something she is determined to resist with all her strength, but her time with Claude leaves her feeling suspicious, restless, and uncertain. Lorsqu'elle se réveille dans un monde étranger, dans la peau de la duchesse Aila Rinehart, une chose est certaine pour Baek Hayul : elle doit s'échapper à tout prix. Son époux, le duc Claude Rinehart, n'est autre que l'antagoniste de l'histoire « Prince, mon prince », qui se fait exécuter après avoir planifié une rébellion contre la Couronne. Hayul, bien décidée à éviter de mourir aux côtés de son époux, lui demande le divorce, mais lorsque celui-ci refuse encore et encore, elle se résout à lui proposer un marché : il a un mois pour la faire tomber amoureuse de lui et revenir sur sa décision. Alors qu'elle est bien décidée à ne pas se laisser attendrir, les moments passés avec Claude finissent par l'emplir de doutes et d'incertitudes. A young woman sick with an incurable illness closes her eyes for the last time, only to wake up as Ariel Winston, an antagonist of the novel she had loved reading before her death. description.en:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much--where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see ten?
___
I squandered my salary to strengthen my game character, and became the lowest-ranking extra in the game. But… [◆Fate: On my 9th birthday, I will be horribly murdered by my father.] No, what is my fate?! It was unfair that I dimensionally shifted while playing a game, but now I will die by my father’s hand… I can’t just sit back and accept this crappy fate. Since it has come to this, I will overcome my fate myself!

Consciente de son rôle secondaire, elle décide de changer sa destinée en influençant les événements du récit. À mesure qu'elle prend les choses en main, elle noue des relaitons stratégiques et cherche à éviter les tragédies prévues pour les personnages principaux. À travers cette quête, elle cherche à sortir de l'ombre et prendre son destin en main.

A being that appears to be human, but is stronger than them, Shil. These mysterious beings scattered throughout the world, remain dormant unless Simeone bestows them with a name. After that, their only purpose is to protect that person. Julitan, a simple cook in a small fishing village, encounters a Shil and gives her a name that resembles her crimsom eyes. “Please, tell me my name”. description.en: Only music sustained me from the maddening pain. If only I could hear my music... with my own ears... Even as my soul was falling apart, I prayed to God... and prayed again. Ludwig van Beethoven is considered the greatest composer in human history. I closed my eyes like that. And 180 years later in Seoul. The saint of music, known as an immortal genius, has been reborn. <Beethoven Born Again> And then I began to hear the voice of an angel. "Dobin.. Dobin.." Only music sustained me from the maddening pain.

The empress of a fallen nation was dragged to the enemy empire. Despite everything, the Treasure of Grandel was still gorgeous. However, in the end she was just a captive who was going to be hanged by the savages. Eliza wanted to avoid that outcome no matter what, even if she had to tell outrageous lies. There was only one option: the man known as Banella's guard dog, the enemy empire's commander, and a lowly and vicious warrior—Lezet Christian. Eliza had to convince this cold and obstinate man who stood before her.

In a trembling voice, she said, "I'll give you a child."

description.en:
Born and raised as a slave in the arena, Happy survived by relying on nothing but his monstrous strength. When his master is executed and the arena collapses, Happy is finally freed for the first time in his life. Now, stepping into a world he barely understands, he begins to learn about family, friendship, and society— one painful, awkward step at a time.

But the world refuses to let him rest. His identity as a former slave The endless wars against crime The buried secrets of his birth. All of them drag Happy into new battles, each more brutal than the last. Through it all, he grows— beyond a mere fighter, beyond a monster— rising until he stands at the very pinnacle of the world.

From the bloodstained sands of the arena to the peak of power, this is the story of the boy who never forgot how to smile.

description.en:
After getting into an accident, I reincarnated into a novel I’d started reading but ultimately gave up on.

“Squeak!” (What the?!)

…Specifically, I reincarnated as a hamster that didn’t appear even once in the story!

[Current Miracle Value: 1%]
[Try raising your Miracle Value. We’ll save you from death!]

I, who had become a tiny hamster, was given a quest to cause “miracles” in this world. Only then could I return to my original body.

“What about saving Kyle? That’s a type of miracle.”

[Target decision complete: Save Kyle Jane Meinhardt.]
[Selecting quest…]

However, when I made up my mind to save Kyle (the reason I stopped reading the novel) from his upcoming death…

“Why are you trying to dance with me when there are a lot of people over there?!”
“Why? Because you are my only pet among all those people.”

I managed to use my Miracle Values to temporarily become a human, which is good, but…

Is it just my imagination, or is life as a human harder than life as a rodent?

“If I tie you up, will you not disappear?”
“...Confinement is a crime, you know?”

Will I be able to save Kyle and bring about a happy ending in his world?
